headline: Star Wars and M&Ms strange Leia crossover
post:
Remember when Star Wars teamed up with M&M's back in 2005 for the Mpire line? That quirky collaboration brought us figures of Darth Vader, Luke Skywalker, and Chewbacca, but the Princess Leia version took things in a very unique direction. 🍫

By blending Leia with the green M&M, the figure featured an open robe look, knee-high boots, and a miniskirt. It has certainly become one of the most talked-about crossover pieces from that era!

headline: James Gunn discusses potential Krills TV series
post:
James Gunn recently shared that he has talked about bringing back the character Abner Krill, also known as Polka-Dot Man from The Suicide Squad, for a potential television series tentatively called The Krills.

According to Gunn, the proposed show would focus on Abner’s mother and their many superhero children, exploring what happened to the rest of the family in a prequel story. While the project has been discussed, it is not currently in active development.

#JamesGunn #DCU #PolkaDotMan
original_title: James Gunn Reveals the Secret Spinoff That DC Studios Has Discussed And It Could Change Established Characters

headline: Absolute Batman introduces Barbara Gordon as the Bat
post:
Hey superhero fans! Big changes are shaking up Gotham City in the pages of DC Comics. According to Screen Rant, Barbara Gordon has arrived as "the Bat" in Absolute Batman #25, stepping into the role as Batman's potential permanent new sidekick. She swoops in during a brutal Batcave battle with Joker to save Bruce Wayne. But unlike traditional sidekicks, she brings zero levity to the dark series, remaining totally consumed by her personal vengeance regarding the murder of Jim Gordon.

Interestingly, Harley Quinn has actually spent a lot more time by Bruce's side and shares a fun rapport with him, while Alfred Pennyworth announced he is ditching the Bat-Family for a time. Barbara is mainly focused on uncovering the truth about her father's past, leaving plenty of wild questions about where her journey leads next. 🦇

What do you think of Barbara taking on this brand new mantle in the Absolute universe?

#AbsoluteBatman #BarbaraGordon #DCComics
original_title: DC Officially Replaces Robin As Batman’s Main Sidekick

post:

headline: DC reveals heartbreaking backstory for Justice League hero Cadejos
post:
Hey everyone! We finally have the full, tragic history of one of the coolest new heroes to join the Justice League Unlimited roster. According to Screen Rant, the latest issue of DC Comics explores how Andrés Aguilar gained his incredible powers. 

Introduced in Absolute Power #3, Andrés can transform into a fiery, towering werewolf-like figure. Justice League: The Dark Realm Special #1 reveals he made a deal with the Cadejos entity to gain the power needed to rescue his young daughter, Victoria, after she was kidnapped by a demonic, beetle-like monster. Teamed up with heroes like Blue Beetle and Zatanna, Andrés recently gave up control of his body to the spirit wolf to help close a portal to the Dark Realm and rescue another little girl. 

Even though the portal is closed, the terrifying Dark Realm breach may have let in more threats, and a cancer manifestation hinted that Darkseid showed it the path to Earth. Despite these looming dangers, Andrés and Cadejos are still determined to find Victoria someday. 🐺✨

What is your favorite new comic book storyline right now?

#JusticeLeague #DCComics #Cadejos
original_title: DC Explains Full Backstory Of Justice League's Best New Hero
